note: Lolo NF campground east of Rock Creek in the Ranch Creek drainage, ~12.5 mi south of I-90 exit 126 at ~4,200 ft; several sites border the creek. Access is up the narrow, rough Rock Creek and Ranch Creek roads (max ~32 ft); passable by a normal vehicle but tight for big rigs. --Claude
summary: Forest Service page (updated Sept 2026) confirms first-come only, potable water, the $15 fee (fees already recorded, left) and a late-May to mid-September season (2026 closed 9/28); added flush toilets. Not stated: site count (derived 9 left), max length. Note corrected (the campground is in the Ranch Creek drainage east of Rock Creek) and trimmed of restated values.
